provenance.descriptions: Microsoft Learn reference descriptions; function names and arity are documentation facts.

entries.name: query.above_top_solid
entries.description: Returns the height of the block immediately above the highest solid block at the input (x,z) position.

entries.name: query.actor_count
entries.description: Returns the number of entities (actors) rendered in the last frame.

entries.name: query.all
entries.description: Evaluates the first argument, then returns 1.0 if all of the following arguments evaluate to the same value as the first.
restrictions: Requires at least 3 arguments.

entries.name: query.all_animations_finished
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if all animations in the current animation controller state have played through at least once, else it returns 0.0.
restrictions: Only valid in an animation controller.

entries.name: query.all_tags
entries.description: Returns if the item or block has all of the tags specified.

entries.name: query.anger_level
entries.description: Returns the anger level of the entity [0,n).
restrictions: Available on the Server only.

entries.name: query.anim_time
entries.description: Returns the time in seconds since the current animation started, else 0.0 if not called within an animation.

entries.name: query.any
entries.description: Evaluates the first argument, then returns 1.0 if any of the following arguments evaluate to the same value as the first.
restrictions: Requires at least 3 arguments.

entries.name: query.any_animation_finished
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if any animation in the current animation controller state has played through at least once, else it returns 0.0.
restrictions: Only valid in an animation controller.

entries.name: query.any_tag
entries.description: Returns if the item or block has any of the tags specified.

entries.name: query.approx_eq
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if all of the arguments are within the smallest unit of measurement possible for the computer running this query of each other, else 0.0.

entries.name: query.armor_color_slot
entries.description: Takes the armor slot index as a parameter, and returns the color of the armor in the requested slot.

entries.name: query.armor_damage_slot
entries.description: Takes the armor slot index as a parameter, and returns the damage value of the requested slot.
restrictions: Support for entities other than players may be limited, as the damage value is not always available on clients.

entries.name: query.armor_material_slot
entries.description: Takes the armor slot index as a parameter, and returns the armor material type in the requested armor slot.

entries.name: query.armor_texture_slot
entries.description: Takes the armor slot index as a parameter, and returns the texture type of the requested slot.

entries.name: query.average_frame_time
entries.description: Returns the time in seconds of the average frame time over the last 'n' frames.
restrictions: Asking for more frames will result in only sampling the number of frames stored.

entries.name: query.base_swing_duration
entries.description: Returns the duration of the mob's swing/attack animation, determined by the carried item and unmodified by effects applied on the mob.

entries.name: query.blocking
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is blocking, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.block_face
entries.description: Returns the block face for this (only valid for certain triggers such as placing blocks, or interacting with block) (Down=0.0, Up=1.0, North=2.0, South=3.0, West=4.0, East=5.0, Undefined=6.0).
restrictions: Returns the block face for this (only valid for certain triggers such as placing blocks, or interacting with block) (Down=0.

entries.name: query.block_has_all_tags
entries.description: Takes a world-origin-relative position and one or more tag names, and returns either 0 or 1 based on if the block at that position has all of the tags provided.

entries.name: query.block_has_any_tag
entries.description: Takes a world-origin-relative position and one or more tag names, and returns either 0 or 1 based on if the block at that position has any of the tags provided.

entries.name: query.block_neighbor_has_all_tags
entries.description: Takes a block-relative position and one or more tag names, and returns either 0 or 1 based on if the block at that position has all of the tags provided.

entries.name: query.block_neighbor_has_any_tag
entries.description: Takes a block-relative position and one or more tag names, and returns either 0 or 1 based on if the block at that position has any of the tags provided.

entries.name: query.block_state
entries.description: Returns the value of the associated block's block state.

entries.name: query.body_x_rotation
entries.description: Returns the body pitch rotation if called on an entity, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.body_y_rotation
entries.description: Returns the body yaw rotation if called on an entity, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.bone_aabb
entries.description: Returns the axis aligned bounding box of a bone as a structure with members '.min', '.max', along with '.x', '.y', and '.z' values for each.

entries.name: query.bone_orientation_matrix
entries.description: Returns the bone orientation (as a matrix) of the desired bone provided it exists in the queryable geometry of the mob, else this returns the identity matrix and throws a content error.

entries.name: query.bone_orientation_trs
entries.description: Returns the bone orientation matrix decomposed into the component translation/rotation/scale (TRS) parts of the desired bone provided it exists in the queryable geometry of the mob, else this returns the identity matrix and throws a content error.

entries.name: query.bone_origin
entries.description: Returns the initial (from the .geo) pivot of a bone as a structure with members '.x', '.y', and '.z'.

entries.name: query.bone_rotation
entries.description: Returns the initial (from the .geo) rotation of a bone as a structure with members '.x', '.y', and '.z' in degrees.

entries.name: query.camera_distance_range_lerp
entries.description: Takes two distances (any order) and return a number from 0 to 1 based on the camera distance between the two ranges clamped to that range.

entries.name: query.camera_rotation
entries.description: Returns the rotation of the camera.
restrictions: Requires one argument representing the rotation axis you would like (0 for x, 1 for y).

entries.name: query.can_climb
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity can climb, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.can_damage_nearby_mobs
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity can damage nearby mobs, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.can_dash
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity can dash, else it returns 0.0

entries.name: query.can_fly
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity can fly, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.can_power_jump
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity can power jump, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.can_swim
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity can swim, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.can_walk
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity can walk, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.cape_flap_amount
entries.description: Returns value between 0.0 and 1.0 with 0.0 meaning cape is fully down and 1.0 is cape is fully up.

entries.name: query.cardinal_facing
entries.description: Returns the current facing of the player (Down=0.0, Up=1.0, North=2.0, South=3.0, West=4.0, East=5.0, Undefined=6.0).

entries.name: query.cardinal_facing_2d
entries.description: Returns the current facing of the player ignoring up/down part of the direction (North=2.0, South=3.0, West=4.0, East=5.0, Undefined=6.0).

entries.name: query.cardinal_player_facing
entries.description: Returns the current facing of the player (Down=0.0, Up=1.0, North=2.0, South=3.0, West=4.0, East=5.0, Undefined=6.0).

entries.name: query.client_max_render_distance
entries.description: Returns the max render distance in chunks of the current client.
restrictions: Available on the Client (Resource Packs) only.

entries.name: query.client_memory_tier
entries.description: Returns a number representing the client RAM memory tier, 0 = 'SuperLow', 1 = 'Low', 2 = 'Mid', 3 = 'High', or 4 = 'SuperHigh'.
restrictions: Available on the Client (Resource Packs) only.

entries.name: query.combine_entities
entries.description: Combines any valid entity references from all arguments into a single array.

entries.name: query.cooldown_time
entries.description: Returns the total cooldown time in seconds for the item held or worn by the specified equipment slot name (and if required second numerical slot id), otherwise returns 0.

entries.name: query.cooldown_time_remaining
entries.description: Returns the cooldown time remaining in seconds for specified cooldown type or the item held or worn by the specified equipment slot name (and if required second numerical slot id), otherwise returns 0.

entries.name: query.count
entries.description: Counts the number of things passed to it (arrays are counted as the number of elements they contain; non-arrays count as 1).

entries.name: query.current_squish_value
entries.description: Returns the squish value for the current entity, or 0.0 if this doesn't make sense.

entries.name: query.day
entries.description: Returns the day of the current world.

entries.name: query.death_ticks
entries.description: Returns the elapsed ticks since the mob started dying.

entries.name: query.delta_time
entries.description: Returns the time in seconds since the previous frame.

entries.name: query.distance_from_camera
entries.description: Returns the distance of the root of this entity or particle emitter from the camera.

entries.name: query.effect_emitter_count
entries.description: Returns the total number of active emitters of the callee's particle effect type.

entries.name: query.effect_particle_count
entries.description: Returns the total number of active particles of the callee's particle effect type.

entries.name: query.entity_biome_has_all_tags
entries.description: Compares the biome the entity is standing in with one or more tag names, and returns either 0 or 1 based on if all of the tag names match.
restrictions: Only supported in resource packs (client-side).

entries.name: query.entity_biome_has_any_identifier
entries.description: Compares the biome the entity is standing in with one or more identifier names, and returns either 0 or 1 based on if any of the identifier names match.
restrictions: Only supported in resource packs (client-side).

entries.name: query.entity_biome_has_any_tags
entries.description: Compares the biome the entity is standing in with one or more tag names, and returns either 0 or 1 based on if any of the tag names match.
restrictions: Only supported in resource packs (client-side).

entries.name: query.equipment_count
entries.description: Returns the number of equipped armor pieces for an entity from 0 to 5, not counting items held in hands.

entries.name: query.equipped_item_all_tags
entries.description: Takes a slot name followed by any tag you want to check for in the form of 'tag_name' and returns 1 if all of the tags are on that equipped item, 0 otherwise.

entries.name: query.equipped_item_any_tag
entries.description: Takes a slot name followed by any tag you want to check for in the form of 'tag_name' and returns 0 if none of the tags are on that equipped item or 1 if at least 1 tag exists.

entries.name: query.equipped_item_is_attachable
entries.description: Takes the desired hand slot as a parameter (0 or 'main_hand' for main hand, 1 or 'off_hand' for off hand), and returns whether the item is an attachable or not.

entries.name: query.eye_target_x_rotation
entries.description: Returns the X eye rotation of the entity, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.eye_target_y_rotation
entries.description: Returns the Y eye rotation of the entity, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.facing_target_to_range_attack
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is attacking from range (i.e.

entries.name: query.frame_alpha
entries.description: Returns the ratio (from 0 to 1) of how much between AI ticks this frame is being rendered.

entries.name: query.fuse_time
entries.description: Returns the remaining fuse time of the entity.

entries.name: query.get_actor_info_id
entries.description: Returns the integer id of an entity (actor) by its string name.

entries.name: query.get_animation_frame
entries.description: Returns the current texture of an item whose appearance can change (such as a drawn bow).

entries.name: query.get_default_bone_pivot
entries.description: Gets specified axis of the specified bone orientation pivot.

entries.name: query.get_level_seed_based_fraction
entries.description: Returns a value in range [0.0, 1.0] based on the level seed.

entries.name: query.get_locator_offset
entries.description: Gets specified axis of the specified locator offset.

entries.name: query.get_pack_setting
entries.description: Returns value of Pack Setting slider, parameter is name of slider.
restrictions: Available on the Client (Resource Packs) only.

entries.name: query.get_root_locator_offset
entries.description: Gets specified axis of the specified locator offset of the root model.

entries.name: query.graphics_mode_is_any
entries.description: If the graphics mode of the client matches any of the arguments, return 1.0.
restrictions: Available on the Client (Resource Packs) only.

entries.name: query.ground_speed
entries.description: Returns the ground speed of the entity in meters/second.

entries.name: query.had_component_group
entries.description: If the entity is being loaded from data that was last saved with a component_group with the specified name, returns 1.0, otherwise returns 0.0.
restrictions: Usable only in behavior packs when determining the default value for an entity's Property.
Requires one string argument.

entries.name: query.has_all_biome_tags
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the biome at the current placement position has all of the specified tags, else 0.0.

entries.name: query.has_any_biome_tags
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the biome at the current placement position has at least one of the specified tags, else 0.0.

entries.name: query.has_any_family
entries.description: Returns 1 if the entity has any of the specified type families, else 0.

entries.name: query.has_any_leashed_entity_of_type
entries.description: Returns whether or not the entity is currently leashing other entities of the designated types.

entries.name: query.has_armor_slot
entries.description: Takes the armor slot index as a parameter, and returns 1.0 if the entity has armor in the requested slot, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.has_biome_tag
entries.description: Returns whether or not a block placement target has a specific biome tag.

entries.name: query.has_block_state
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the associated block has the given block state or 0.0 if not.

entries.name: query.has_cape
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the player has a cape, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.has_collision
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity has collisions enabled, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.has_dash_cooldown
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity has cooldown on its dash, else it returns 0.0

entries.name: query.has_gravity
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is affected by gravity, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.has_head_gear
entries.description: Returns boolean whether an entity has an item in their head armor slot or not, or false if no entity in current context

entries.name: query.has_owner
entries.description: Returns true if the entity has an owner ID else it returns false.

entries.name: query.has_player_rider
entries.description: Returns 1 if the entity has a player riding it in any seat, else it returns 0.

entries.name: query.has_property
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if a property with the given name exists, 0 otherwise.

entries.name: query.has_rider
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity has a rider, else it returns 0.0

entries.name: query.has_target
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity has a target, else it returns 0.0

entries.name: query.head_is_in_water
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity's head is in water, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.head_roll_angle
entries.description: Returns the roll angle of the head of the entity if it makes sense, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.head_x_rotation
entries.description: Returns the nth head x rotation of the entity if it makes sense, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.head_y_rotation
entries.description: Returns the nth head y rotation of the entity if it makes sense, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.health
entries.description: Returns the health of the entity, or 0.0 if it doesn't make sense to call on this entity.

entries.name: query.heartbeat_interval
entries.description: Returns the heartbeat interval of the entity in seconds.

entries.name: query.heartbeat_phase
entries.description: Returns the heartbeat phase of the entity.
restrictions: Available on the Client (Resource Packs) only.

entries.name: query.heightmap
entries.description: Returns the world height (Y value) of the terrain at the specified position.

entries.name: query.hurt_direction
entries.description: Returns the hurt direction for the entity, otherwise returns 0.

entries.name: query.hurt_time
entries.description: Returns the hurt time for the entity, otherwise returns 0.

entries.name: query.invulnerable_ticks
entries.description: Returns the number of ticks of invulnerability the entity has left if it makes sense, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.in_range
entries.description: If the first argument is between the minimum and maximum (inclusive), returns 1.0.
restrictions: Requires 3 numerical arguments: some value, a minimum, and a maximum.

entries.name: query.is_admiring
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is admiring, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_alive
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is alive, and 0.0 if it's dead.

entries.name: query.is_angry
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is angry, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_attached
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is attached to another entity (such as being held or worn), else it will return 0.0.
restrictions: Available only with resource packs.

entries.name: query.is_attached_to_entity
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is attached to another entity, else it will return 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_avoiding_block
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is fleeing from a block, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_avoiding_mobs
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is fleeing from mobs, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_baby
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity has a is_baby component, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_breathing
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is breathing, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_bribed
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity has been bribed, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_carrying_block
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is carrying a block, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_casting
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is casting, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_celebrating
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is celebrating, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_celebrating_special
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is doing a special celebration, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_charged
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity has the is_charged component, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_charging
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is charging, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_chested
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity has chests attached to it (has the is_chested component), else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_cooldown_category
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the specified held or worn item has the specified cooldown category, otherwise returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_crawling
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is crawling, else it returns 0.0

entries.name: query.is_critical
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is at a critical level of damage, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_croaking
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is croaking, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_dancing
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is dancing, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_delayed_attacking
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is attacking using the delayed attack, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_digging
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is digging, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_eating
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is eating, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_eating_mob
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is eating a mob, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_elder
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is an elder version of it, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_emerging
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is emerging, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_emoting
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is emoting, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_enchanted
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is enchanted, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_fire_immune
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is immune to fire (has the fire_immune component), else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_first_person
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is being rendered in first person mode, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_ghost
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if an entity is a ghost, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_gliding
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is gliding, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_grazing
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is grazing, or 0.0 if not.

entries.name: query.is_idling
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is idling, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_ignited
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is ignited (has the is_ignited component), else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_illager_captain
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is an illager captain (has the is_illager_captain component), else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_interested
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is interested, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_invisible
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is invisible (using render controllers), else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_in_contact_with_water
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is in contact with any water (water, rain, splash water bottle), else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_in_lava
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is in lava, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_in_love
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is in love (has a love-hearts animation), else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_in_ui
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is rendered as part of the UI, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_in_water
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is in water, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_in_water_or_rain
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is in water or rain, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_item_equipped
entries.description: Takes one optional hand slot as a parameter (0 or 'main_hand' for main hand, 1 or 'off_hand' for off hand), and returns 1.0 if there is an item in the requested slot (defaulting to the main hand if no parameter is supplied), otherwise returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_item_name_any
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if an item in the specified slot has any of the specified names, otherwise returns 0.0.
restrictions: chest will only work in behavior packs.

entries.name: query.is_jumping
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is jumping, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_jump_goal_jumping
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is doing a jump goal jump, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_laying_down
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is laying down, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_laying_egg
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is laying an egg, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_leashed
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is leashed to something, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_levitating
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is levitating, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_lingering
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the potion type or effect is lingering, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_local_player
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is the local player for the current game window, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_moving
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is moving, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_name_any
entries.description: Takes one or more arguments.

entries.name: query.is_onfire
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is on fire, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_on_fire
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is on fire, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_on_ground
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is on the ground, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_on_screen
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if this is called on an entity at a time when it is known if it is on screen, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_orphaned
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is orphaned, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_owner_identifier_any
entries.description: Returns whether the root entity identifier is any of the specified strings.

entries.name: query.is_pack_setting_enabled
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the Pack Setting toggle is enabled, parameter is name of toggle.
restrictions: Available on the Client (Resource Packs) only.

entries.name: query.is_pack_setting_selected
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the Pack Setting dropdown or multiselect (first parameter) matches the string value of the second parameter (selection).
restrictions: Available on the Client (Resource Packs) only.

entries.name: query.is_persona_or_premium_skin
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the player has a persona or premium skin, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_playing_dead
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is playing dead, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_powered
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is powered, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_pregnant
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is pregnant, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_ram_attacking
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is using a ram attack, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_resting
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is resting, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_riding
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is riding, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_riding_any_entity_of_type
entries.description: Returns whether or not the entity is currently riding an entity of any of the designated types.

entries.name: query.is_rising
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if behavior.timer_flag_2 is running, else it returns 0.0.
restrictions: DEPRECATED after 1.

entries.name: query.is_roaring
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is currently roaring, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_rolling
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is rolling, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_saddled
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity has a saddle (has the is_saddled component), else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_scared
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is scared, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_scenting
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if behavior.timer_flag_1 is running, else it returns 0.0.
restrictions: DEPRECATED after 1.

entries.name: query.is_searching
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is searching, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_selected_item
entries.description: Returns true if the player has selected an item in the inventory, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_shaking
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is shaking, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_shaking_wetness
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is shaking water off, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_sheared
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is able to be sheared and is sheared, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_shield_powered
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity has an active powered shield if it makes sense, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_silent
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is silent, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_sitting
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is sitting, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_sleeping
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is sleeping, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_sneaking
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is sneaking, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_sneezing
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is sneezing, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_sniffing
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is sniffing, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_sonic_boom
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is using sonic boom, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_spectator
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity (player) is in spectator mode, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_sprinting
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is sprinting, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_stackable
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is stackable (has the is_stackable component), else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_stalking
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is stalking, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_standing
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is standing, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_stunned
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is currently stunned, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_swimming
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is swimming, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_tamed
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is tamed, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_transforming
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is transforming, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_using_item
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is using an item, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.is_wall_climbing
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is climbing a wall, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.item_in_use_duration
entries.description: Returns the amount of time an item has been in use in seconds up to the maximum duration, else 0.0 if it doesn't make sense.

entries.name: query.item_is_charged
entries.description: Takes one optional hand slot as a parameter (0 or 'main_hand' for main hand, 1 or 'off_hand' for off hand), and returns 1.0 if the item is charged in the requested slot (defaulting to the main hand if no parameter is supplied), otherwise returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.item_max_use_duration
entries.description: Returns the maximum amount of time the item can be used, else 0.0 if it doesn't make sense.

entries.name: query.item_remaining_use_duration
entries.description: Returns the amount of time an item has left to use, else 0.0 if it doesn't make sense.
restrictions: Time remaining is normalized using the normalization value, only if one is given, else it is returned in seconds.

entries.name: query.item_slot_to_bone_name
entries.description: This function returns the name of the bone this entity has mapped to that slot.
restrictions: item_slot_to_bone_name requires one parameter: the name of the equipment slot.

entries.name: query.key_frame_lerp_time
entries.description: Returns the ratio between the previous and next key frames.

entries.name: query.kinetic_weapon_damage_duration
entries.description: Returns the "max_duration" value of "damage_conditions" from the main-hand item's "minecraft:kinetic_weapon" component, or 0 if the component is not present.

entries.name: query.kinetic_weapon_delay
entries.description: Returns the "delay" value from the main-hand item's "minecraft:kinetic_weapon" component, or 0 if the component is not present.

entries.name: query.kinetic_weapon_dismount_duration
entries.description: Returns the "max_duration" value of "dismount_conditions" from the main-hand item's "minecraft:kinetic_weapon" component, or 0 if the component is not present.

entries.name: query.kinetic_weapon_knockback_duration
entries.description: Returns the "max_duration" value of "knockback_conditions" from the main-hand item's "minecraft:kinetic_weapon" component, or 0 if the component is not present.

entries.name: query.last_frame_time
entries.description: Returns the time in seconds of the last frame.
restrictions: Passing an index more than the available data will return the oldest frame stored.

entries.name: query.last_hit_by_player
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity was last hit by the player, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.last_input_mode_is_any
entries.description: Takes one or more arguments ('keyboard_and_mouse', 'touch', or 'gamepad').
restrictions: Available on the Client (Resource Packs) only.

entries.name: query.leashed_entity_count
entries.description: Returns the number of entities for which this entity is the leash holder.

entries.name: query.lie_amount
entries.description: Returns the lie down amount for the entity.

entries.name: query.life_span
entries.description: Returns the limited life span of an entity, or 0.0 if it lives forever.

entries.name: query.life_time
entries.description: Returns the time in seconds since the current animation started, else 0.0 if not called within an animation.

entries.name: query.log
entries.description: Debug log a value to the content file.

entries.name: query.main_hand_item_max_duration
entries.description: Returns the use time maximum duration for the main hand item if it makes sense, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.main_hand_item_use_duration
entries.description: Returns the use time for the main hand item.

entries.name: query.mark_variant
entries.description: Returns the entity's mark variant value, if the entity has the mark_variant component.

entries.name: query.maximum_frame_time
entries.description: Returns the time in seconds of the most expensive frame over the last 'n' frames.
restrictions: Asking for more frames will result in only sampling the number of frames stored.

entries.name: query.max_durability
entries.description: Returns the max durability an item can take.

entries.name: query.max_health
entries.description: Returns the maximum health of the entity, or 0.0 if it doesn't make sense to call on this entity.

entries.name: query.max_trade_tier
entries.description: Returns the maximum trade tier of the entity if it can perform trades, else it returns 0.0

entries.name: query.minimum_frame_time
entries.description: Returns the time in seconds of the least expensive frame over the last 'n' frames.
restrictions: Asking for more frames will result in only sampling the number of frames stored.

entries.name: query.model_scale
entries.description: Returns the scale of the current entity.

entries.name: query.modified_distance_moved
entries.description: Returns the total distance the entity has moved horizontally in meters (since the entity was last loaded, not necessarily since it was originally created).

entries.name: query.modified_move_speed
entries.description: Returns the current walk speed of the entity.

entries.name: query.modified_swing_duration
entries.description: Returns the duration of the mob's swing/attack animation, determined by the carried item and modified by effects applied on the mob.

entries.name: query.moon_brightness
entries.description: Returns the brightness of the moon (FULL_MOON=1.0, WANING_GIBBOUS=0.75, FIRST_QUARTER=0.5, WANING_CRESCENT=0.25, NEW_MOON=0.0, WAXING_CRESCENT=0.25, LAST_QUARTER=0.5, WAXING_GIBBOUS=0.75).

entries.name: query.moon_phase
entries.description: Returns the phase of the moon (FULL_MOON=0, WANING_GIBBOUS=1, FIRST_QUARTER=2, WANING_CRESCENT=3, NEW_MOON=4, WAXING_CRESCENT=5, LAST_QUARTER=6, WAXING_GIBBOUS=7).

entries.name: query.movement_direction
entries.description: Returns the specified axis of the normalized position delta of the entity.

entries.name: query.noise
entries.description: Queries a Perlin Noise Map.

entries.name: query.on_fire_time
entries.description: Returns the time that the entity is on fire, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.out_of_control
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is out of control (has the out_of_control component), else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.player_level
entries.description: Returns the players level if the entity is a player, otherwise returns 0.

entries.name: query.position
entries.description: Returns the absolute position of an entity.

entries.name: query.position_delta
entries.description: Returns the position delta for an entity.

entries.name: query.previous_squish_value
entries.description: Returns the previous squish value for the current entity, or 0.0 if this doesn't make sense.

entries.name: query.property
entries.description: Returns the value of that property if it exists, else 0.0 if not.

entries.name: query.relative_block_has_all_tags
entries.description: Takes an entity-relative position and one or more tag names, and returns either 0 or 1 based on if the block at that position has all of the tags provided.

entries.name: query.relative_block_has_any_tag
entries.description: Takes an entity-relative position and one or more tag names, and returns either 0 or 1 based on if the block at that position has any of the tags provided.

entries.name: query.remaining_durability
entries.description: Returns how much durability an item has remaining.

entries.name: query.rider_body_x_rotation
entries.description: Returns the body pitch world-rotation of a valid rider at the provided index if called on an entity, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.rider_body_y_rotation
entries.description: Returns the body yaw world-rotation of a valid rider at the provided index if called on an entity, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.rider_head_x_rotation
entries.description: Returns the head x world-rotation of the rider entity at the provided index, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.rider_head_y_rotation
entries.description: Returns the head y world-rotation of the rider entity at the provided index, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.ride_body_x_rotation
entries.description: Returns the body pitch world-rotation of the ride an entity, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.ride_body_y_rotation
entries.description: Returns the body yaw world-rotation of the ride of on an entity, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.ride_head_x_rotation
entries.description: Returns the head x world-rotation of the ride of an entity, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.ride_head_y_rotation
entries.description: Returns the head y world-rotation of the ride of an entity, else it returns 0.0.
restrictions: First parameter only for horses, zombie horses, skeleton horses, donkeys and mules that clamps rotation in degrees.

entries.name: query.roll_counter
entries.description: Returns the roll counter of the entity.

entries.name: query.rotation_to_camera
entries.description: Returns the rotation required to aim at the camera.
restrictions: Requires one argument representing the rotation axis you would like (0 for x, 1 for y).

entries.name: query.scoreboard
entries.description: Returns the specified scoreboard value for this entity.
restrictions: Available only with behavior packs.

entries.name: query.server_memory_tier
entries.description: Returns a number representing the server RAM memory tier, 0 = 'SuperLow', 1 = 'Low', 2 = 'Mid', 3 = 'High', or 4 = 'SuperHigh'.
restrictions: Available on the server side (Behavior Packs) only.

entries.name: query.shake_angle
entries.description: Returns the shaking angle of the entity if it makes sense, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.shake_time
entries.description: Returns the shake time of the entity.

entries.name: query.shield_blocking_bob
entries.description: Returns the how much the offhand shield should translate down when blocking and being hit.

entries.name: query.show_bottom
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if we render the entity's bottom, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.sit_amount
entries.description: Returns the current sit amount of the entity.

entries.name: query.skin_id
entries.description: Returns the entity's skin ID (related to the skin_id component).

entries.name: query.sleep_rotation
entries.description: Returns the rotation of the bed the player is sleeping on.

entries.name: query.sneeze_counter
entries.description: Returns the sneeze counter of the entity.

entries.name: query.spellcolor
entries.description: Returns a struct representing the entity spell color for the specified entity.

entries.name: query.standing_scale
entries.description: Returns the scale of how standing up the entity is.

entries.name: query.state_time
entries.description: Returns the time in seconds in the current animation controller state.
restrictions: Only valid in an animation controller.

entries.name: query.structural_integrity
entries.description: Returns the structural integrity for the entity, otherwise returns 0.

entries.name: query.surface_particle_color
entries.description: Returns the particle color for the block located in the surface below the entity (scanned up to 10 blocks down).
restrictions: Available on the Client (Resource Packs) only.

entries.name: query.surface_particle_texture_coordinate
entries.description: Returns the texture coordinate for generating particles for the block located in the surface below the entity (scanned up to 10 blocks down) in a structure with 'u' and 'v' keys.
restrictions: Available on the Client (Resource Packs) only.

entries.name: query.surface_particle_texture_size
entries.description: Returns the texture size for generating particles for the block located in the surface below the entity (scanned up to 10 blocks down).
restrictions: Available on the Client (Resource Packs) only.

entries.name: query.swelling_dir
entries.description: Returns the swelling direction of the entity if it makes sense, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.swell_amount
entries.description: Returns how swollen an entity is.
restrictions: Only works for "minecraft:creeper" and "minecraft:wither".

entries.name: query.swim_amount
entries.description: Returns the amount the current entity is swimming.

entries.name: query.tail_angle
entries.description: Returns the angle of the tail of the entity if it makes sense, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.target_x_rotation
entries.description: Returns the x rotation required to aim at the entity's current target if it has one, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.target_y_rotation
entries.description: Returns the y rotation required to aim at the entity's current target if it has one, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.ticks_since_last_kinetic_weapon_hit
entries.description: Returns the number of ticks elapsed since the user last hit something while using a kinetic weapon.

entries.name: query.timer_flag_1
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if behavior.timer_flag_1 is running, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.timer_flag_2
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if behavior.timer_flag_2 is running, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.timer_flag_3
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if behavior.timer_flag_3 is running, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.time_of_day
entries.description: Returns the time of day (midnight=0.0, sunrise=0.25, noon=0.5, sunset=0.75) of the dimension the entity is in.

entries.name: query.time_since_last_vibration_detection
entries.description: Returns the time in seconds since the last vibration detected by the entity.
restrictions: Available on the Client (Resource Packs) only.

entries.name: query.time_stamp
entries.description: Returns the current time stamp of the level.

entries.name: query.total_emitter_count
entries.description: Returns the total number of active emitters in the world.

entries.name: query.total_particle_count
entries.description: Returns the total number of active particles in the world.

entries.name: query.touch_only_affects_hotbar
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the touch input only affects the touchbar, otherwise returns 0.0.
restrictions: 0 if the touch input only affects the touchbar, otherwise returns 0.
Available on the Client (Resource Packs) only.

entries.name: query.trade_tier
entries.description: Returns the trade tier of the entity if it makes sense, else it returns 0.0.

entries.name: query.variant
entries.description: Returns the entity's variant index.

entries.name: query.vertical_speed
entries.description: Returns the speed of the entity up or down in meters/second, where positive is up.

entries.name: query.walk_distance
entries.description: Returns the total distance traveled by an entity while on the ground and not sneaking.

entries.name: query.wing_flap_position
entries.description: Returns the wing flap position of the entity, or 0.0 if this doesn't make sense.

entries.name: query.wing_flap_speed
entries.description: Returns the wing flap speed of the entity, or 0.0 if this doesn't make sense.

entries.name: query.yaw_speed
entries.description: Returns the entity's yaw speed.

entries.name: query.block_property
entries.description: Returns the value of the associated block's block state.

entries.name: query.cardinal_block_face_placed_on
entries.description: Returns the block face for this (only valid for on_placed_by_player trigger) (Down=0.0, Up=1.0, North=2.0, South=3.0, West=4.0, East=5.0, Undefined=6.0).
restrictions: DEPRECATED (please use query.
block_face instead) Returns the block face for this (only valid for on_placed_by_player trigger) (Down=0.

entries.name: query.dash_cooldown_progress
entries.description: Returns dash cooldown progress if the entity can dash, else it returns 0.0.
restrictions: DEPRECATED.

entries.name: query.debug_output
entries.description: Debug log a value to the output debug window for builds that have one.

entries.name: query.get_equipped_item_name
entries.description: Takes one optional hand slot as a parameter (0 or 'main_hand' for main hand, 1 or 'off_hand' for off hand), and a second parameter (0=default) if you would like the equipped item or any non-zero number for the currently rendered item, and returns the name of the item in the requested slot (defaulting to the main hand if no parameter is supplied) if there is one, otherwise returns ''.
restrictions: DEPRECATED (Use query.

entries.name: query.get_name
entries.description: Get the name of the mob if there is one, otherwise return ''.
restrictions: DEPRECATED (Use query.

entries.name: query.has_block_property
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if the associated block has the given block state or 0.0 if not.

entries.name: query.is_feeling_happy
entries.description: Returns 1.0 if behavior.timer_flag_2 is running, else it returns 0.0.
restrictions: DEPRECATED after 1.

entries.name: query.overlay_alpha
entries.description: Deprecated; this function is deprecated and will be removed.
restrictions: DEPRECATED (Do not use - this function is deprecated and will be removed).

entries.name: query.owner_identifier
entries.description: Returns the root entity identifier.
restrictions: DEPRECATED (Use query.

entries.name: query.unhappy_counter
entries.description: Always returns zero.
restrictions: (Was originally meant to indicate Panda unhappiness but due to an early code change it has always only returned zero)

entries.name: math.abs
entries.description: Absolute value of value

entries.name: math.acos
entries.description: arccos of value

entries.name: math.asin
entries.description: arcsin of value

entries.name: math.atan
entries.description: arctan of value

entries.name: math.atan2
entries.description: arctan of y/x.

entries.name: math.ceil
entries.description: Round value up to nearest integral number

entries.name: math.clamp
entries.description: Clamp value to between min and max inclusive

entries.name: math.copy_sign
entries.description: Compose a floating-point value with the magnitude of x and the sign of y.

entries.name: math.cos
entries.description: Cosine (in degrees) of value

entries.name: math.die_roll
entries.description: Returns the sum of 'num' random numbers, each with a value from low to high.

entries.name: math.die_roll_integer
entries.description: Returns the sum of 'num' random integer numbers, each with a value from low to high.

entries.name: math.ease_in_back
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, overshooting backward before accelerating into the end

entries.name: math.ease_in_bounce
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting with bounce oscillations and settling into the end

entries.name: math.ease_in_circ
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting slow and accelerating along a circular curve toward the end

entries.name: math.ease_in_cubic
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting slow and accelerating rapidly toward the end

entries.name: math.ease_in_elastic
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting with elastic oscillations before accelerating into the end

entries.name: math.ease_in_expo
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting slow and accelerating extremely rapidly toward the end

entries.name: math.ease_in_out_back
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, overshooting at both start and end, with smoother change in the middle

entries.name: math.ease_in_out_bounce
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting and ending with bounce oscillations, smoother in the middle

entries.name: math.ease_in_out_circ
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting and ending slow, with circular acceleration and deceleration in the middle

entries.name: math.ease_in_out_cubic
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting slow, accelerating rapidly in the middle, then slowing again at the end

entries.name: math.ease_in_out_elastic
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, oscillating elastically at both start and end, with stable change in the middle

entries.name: math.ease_in_out_expo
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting and ending slow, with extremely rapid change in the middle

entries.name: math.ease_in_out_quad
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting slow, accelerating in the middle, then slowing again at the end

entries.name: math.ease_in_out_quart
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting slow, accelerating very rapidly in the middle, then slowing again at the end

entries.name: math.ease_in_out_quint
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting slow, accelerating extremely rapidly in the middle, then slowing again at the end

entries.name: math.ease_in_out_sine
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting and ending slow, with smoother change in the middle

entries.name: math.ease_in_quad
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting slow and accelerating toward the end

entries.name: math.ease_in_quart
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting slow and accelerating very rapidly toward the end

entries.name: math.ease_in_quint
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting slow and accelerating extremely rapidly toward the end

entries.name: math.ease_in_sine
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting slow and accelerating smoothly toward the end

entries.name: math.ease_out_back
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, overshooting past the end before settling into it

entries.name: math.ease_out_bounce
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, approaching the end with bounce oscillations that diminish over time

entries.name: math.ease_out_circ
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting fast and decelerating along a circular curve toward the end

entries.name: math.ease_out_cubic
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting fast and decelerating rapidly toward the end

entries.name: math.ease_out_elastic
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, overshooting the end with elastic oscillations before settling

entries.name: math.ease_out_expo
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting extremely fast and decelerating gradually toward the end

entries.name: math.ease_out_quad
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting fast and decelerating toward the end

entries.name: math.ease_out_quart
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting fast and decelerating very rapidly toward the end

entries.name: math.ease_out_quint
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting fast and decelerating extremely rapidly toward the end

entries.name: math.ease_out_sine
entries.description: Output goes from start to end via 0_to_1, starting fast and decelerating smoothly toward the end

entries.name: math.exp
entries.description: Returns e raised to the value power

entries.name: math.floor
entries.description: Round value down to nearest integral number

entries.name: math.hermite_blend
entries.description: Interpolate points on a smooth curve using one of the Hermite Basis functions: 3t^2 - 2t^3.

entries.name: math.inverse_lerp
entries.description: Returns the normalized progress between start and end given value

entries.name: math.lerp
entries.description: Computes the linear interpolation between a and b with interpolation weighting factor t in the range [0, 1], where 0 = a and 1 = b.

entries.name: math.lerprotate
entries.description: Computes a linear interpolation around a circle in the shortest direction from a degrees to b degrees with interpolation weighting factor t (see math.lerp).

entries.name: math.ln
entries.description: Natural logarithm of value

entries.name: math.max
entries.description: Return highest value of A or B

entries.name: math.min
entries.description: Return lowest value of A or B

entries.name: math.min_angle
entries.description: Minimize angle magnitude (in degrees) into the range [-180, 180)

entries.name: math.mod
entries.description: Return the remainder of value / denominator

entries.name: math.pi
entries.description: Returns the float representation of the constant pi.

entries.name: math.pow
entries.description: Elevates base to the exponent'th power

entries.name: math.random
entries.description: Random value between low and high inclusive

entries.name: math.random_integer
entries.description: Random integer value between low and high inclusive

entries.name: math.round
entries.description: Round value to nearest integral number

entries.name: math.sign
entries.description: Returns 1 if value is positive, -1 otherwise

entries.name: math.sin
entries.description: Sine (in degrees) of value

entries.name: math.sqrt
entries.description: Square root of value

entries.name: math.trunc
entries.description: Round value towards zero
